pick.headline: Jerry Rawlings seizes power again in Ghana
pick.summary: On December 31, 1981, Flight Lieutenant Jerry Rawlings overthrew Ghana's elected President Hilla Limann, two years after he had handed power to civilians.

alternates.headline: Military coup in Nigeria
alternates.summary: On December 31, 1983, the Nigerian army overthrew President Shehu Shagari's civilian government; Major General Muhammadu Buhari became head of state.
alternates.significance: The coup ended Nigeria's Second Republic.

alternates.headline: Czechoslovakia dissolves at midnight
alternates.summary: At midnight on December 31, 1992, Czechoslovakia ceased to exist, peacefully dividing into the Czech Republic and Slovakia.
alternates.significance: The 'velvet divorce' contrasted sharply with the bloody breakup of Yugoslavia.
